name: Sakura wa Mada Kaina
source:
An animated novel about a winter tale.
There is a young snow woman named Fubuki, who is attracted to an artist of ice sculpture. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE057445.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一部描绘冬日故事的动画小说。
年轻的雪女吹雪，被一名冰雕艺术家深深吸引。

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE057445.html]DLsite英文站[/url]]
